import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from ranges import clamp, in_range

def check(cond, msg):
    assert cond, msg
    print("ok:", msg)

# clamp: below
check(clamp(3, 5, 10) == 5, "value<lo -> lo")
# clamp: above
check(clamp(11, 5, 10) == 10, "value>hi -> hi")
# clamp: inside -> value
check(clamp(7, 5, 10) == 7, "inside -> value")
# clamp: boundaries
check(clamp(5, 5, 10) == 5, "value==lo -> value")
check(clamp(10, 5, 10) == 10, "value==hi -> value")
# floats / negatives
check(clamp(-3.5, -2.0, 4.0) == -2.0, "float below")
check(clamp(-0.5, -2.0, 4.0) == -0.5, "float inside")

# in_range
check(in_range(5, 5, 10) is True, "lo<=value<=hi: lower bound included")
check(in_range(10, 5, 10) is True, "upper bound included")
check(in_range(7, 5, 10) is True, "middle")
check(in_range(4, 5, 10) is False, "below -> False")
check(in_range(11, 5, 10) is False, "above -> False")
check(in_range(0, 0, 0) is True, "degenerate lo==hi==value")
check(in_range(1, 0, 0) is False, "degenerate outside")

print("ALL RANGES TESTS PASSED")
